---

I opened a draft PR for the new article: [saranatour1/site#88](https://github.com/saranatour1/site/pull/88), on branch `new-article`.

It contains the placeholder you'd already started and its timings file:
- `src/content/articles/hello-narration.md`, which has `draft: true`, so it only shows in `astro dev`
- `public/narration/hello-narration.vtt`

The PR description has a checklist of what's left:
- Replace the placeholder title, slug and text with the real ones.
- Record the mp3 and re-record the timings.
- Set `pubDate` and remove `draft: true` when it's ready.

No CI checks have reported yet. Auto-fix is off; you can turn it on from the PR bar if you want CI failures handled automatically.

I left `.claude/`, `.entire/` and `skills/` out of the commit; they're still untracked. GitHub says the repo has been renamed to `saranatour1/site`, but your local `origin` still points at the old `Personal-Website` URL. The push worked through the redirect, and this command updates it:

```bash
git remote set-url origin https://github.com/saranatour1/site.git
```
